name: record-create
command: Add the evidence-backed amino-sugar catabolism superpathway

name: schema-edit
command: Represent evidence-backed endpoint qualifications and exact EcoCyc identities

Add closed/native schema parity for endpoint_qualifiers and EcoCyc CURIEs. Evidence-backed construct or molecular-state qualifiers remain part of the edge claim in rendered evidence, graph interaction, edge identity and KGX. Existing unqualified edges retain their IDs and cell values, with only an added blank endpoint_qualifiers column. EcoCyc RNA and complexes retain explicit biological categories. The reviewed endpoint and EcoCyc implementation reports and failed preparation lineage remain archived; final maintained preservation is checked separately.

name: authority-code-edit
command: Add bounded native MetaCyc complex, BiGG and EcoCyc authority support

Support native MetaCyc homomer enzyme-name relations with exact back-references, BiGG universal metabolite/reaction names with a verified database-version companion, and EcoCyc direct complex/RNA names and validated aliases. Preserve source identity/type/version/taxon and strict request/XML guards before corpus selection. No contextual-label waiver, chemical equivalence, component coefficient or regulatory claim is inferred by an adapter. Independent implementation reviews and retained-authority CLI reproduction are archived; the root-owned full combined canonical source build and maintained gates are distinct outcomes.
